messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 SSE tail latency spiking >6s in eu-west-1 for streaming endpoints. Automatic routing fallback triggered for some customers. Detected high write stalls and chunk buffering. iOS SDK 1.4.x showing increased disconnects. Paging oncall.

alice_oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime and SRE.

bob_sre: got the page — looking at proxy pool metrics now. Noting increase in upstream write time and many connections in CLOSE_WAIT.

carol_runtime: I'm checking the inference worker logs and kv-cache health. Any live customer reports?

dave_support: several support tickets from the same customer group (mobile app). They see long waits and then partial responses. Ticket IDs: #4521 #4523.

alice_oncall: timeline: spike started ~4312345600. Rolling window p50 normal, p95 ~2s, p99 jumped to 6-8s. Affected route: /v1/stream/chat (SSE).

bob_sre: quick checks: proxy write buffer depth up, OS level send queue high on a subset of frontend nodes. Suspect slow consumers + proxy writeback.

carol_runtime: can we identify if this is client backpressure vs origin generation stalls? I see steady token generation on worker side for most sessions. Worker-side latencies look normal (~50-120ms per token).

erin_network: network note: no cloud network events. ALB metrics show increased backend response time but not 5xxs.

alice_oncall: hypothesis: client slow consumers (iOS SDK) causing TCP-level write buffering leading to proxy backpressure -> pins upstream -> chunk delays.

bob_sre: mitigation idea: enable aggressive write timeout/evict on frontend for suspected slow clients to free pipeline. Also increase proxy pool temporary capacity (scale + add burst nodes).

carol_runtime: also can we enable prefix-eviction for long-running SSE streams to reduce KV pressure? Might help tail.

alice_oncall: actions: 1) bob: start frontend eviction for connections with send_queue > 8MB and idle > 10s (non-productive). 2) ops: scale frontend pool by +20% immediate. 3) carol: enable prefix eviction / reduce keepalive on affected route. 4) dave: notify impacted customers with ETA.

bob_sre: executing eviction script now: ```for node in frontend-pool; do curl -XPOST $node/evict?q=sendq>8MB; done``` I'll monitor error rates.

bob_sre: eviction rolling. Seeing drop in send_queue depth on 3 nodes. Some connections forcibly closed — expected.

alice_oncall: monitoring p99.

carol_runtime: toggled prefix-eviction feature flag for /v1/stream/chat to aggressive. Also lowered SSE keepalive interval from 60s -> 20s for trial.

dave_support: customer notices improvement — intermittent partial responses now fewer. Sending update to tickets.

bob_sre: after eviction + scale, p99 down to ~1.8s, p95 ~450ms. Looks stabilizing. Will keep increased pool for 30m.

erin_network: noting increased connection churn due to evictions. No upstream alarms.

alice_oncall: marking current severity as mitigated but degraded. Continuing watch for 30m. Please capture all logs/traces for postmortem.

carol_runtime: capturing traces and saving to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/4312345679/ (trace ids attached in followups).

bob_sre: added firewall rule tweak rollback plan in case evictions trigger regressions.

alice_oncall: customer-impact summary for handoff: iOS SDK 1.4.x had elevated tail latency causing visible delays and partial payloads for ~12 minutes peak. Root cause likely slow client read patterns combined with conservative proxy send queues. Mitigation: connection eviction + scale + aggressive prefix eviction.

dave_support: I'll send a short status email to affected accounts and offer a follow-up postmortem.

alice_oncall: handing off to oncall-next for watch: @carol_runtime will own followup and postmortem. Please ensure cross-team notes.

carol_runtime: taking over. I'll coordinate a brief postmortem with SRE and Support.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident status updated -> mitigated (degraded). Paging resolved.

alice_oncall: closing paging channel here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
